question: In December 2022, the Union Agriculture Ministry formed an advisory group for streamlining the development of the bamboo sector. Who among the following approved the committee?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Singh Tomar**__

• **Narendra Singh Tomar** approved the advisory group formed by the Union Agriculture Ministry for streamlining the development of the bamboo sector in December 2022.
 
• He is the Minister of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare in the Government of India.
